body.statement: For each fixed \(B\ge1\) and \(0<c\le1\), the constant \(C_{\mathrm N}(B,c)<\infty\) may be chosen so that every member of \(\mathcal M_n(d;B,c)\) satisfies \[d_{\mathrm K}((T_n-\tau_n)/\sigma_n,Z_0)\le\min\left\{1,C_{\mathrm N}(B,c)\left(\frac{D_n^2}{n\lambda_n}+\frac{D_n}{n}\right)^{1/5}\right\}\le\min\left\{1,C_{\mathrm N}(B,c)\left(\frac{D_n^{3/2}}n\right)^{1/5}\right\}.\] Consequently \(K_n(d;B,c)\le\min\{1,C_{\mathrm N}(B,c)(d^{3/2}/n)^{1/5}\}\).
body.justification: This is a candidate quantitative consequence of the independently unverified rank-indexed martingale and prefix-flip bounds.
body.gap: Theorem 5.6 of \cite{KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024CGD} requires \(d=o(n^{1/9})\); direct substitution of Theorem 2.3 of \cite{JanischLehericy2024SparseDependencyGraph} at \(\delta=4\) uses a generic dependency graph and does not attain this bound.
body.consumer: If proved, future CGD replications could check the graph-degree growth rule before replacing conservative Chebyshev calibration by a normal critical value.
